name: Kalgoorlie Gold Mining Limited
summary: Kalgoorlie Gold Mining Limited is a mineral explorer acquiring, investigating and developing resource projects around Kalgoorlie in Western Australia, mainly for lead, gold and nickel. Its holdings in the district include Bulong, Perrinvale, Pianto South and Davies Dam, plus the Laverton and Keith-Kilkenny tectonic zones. It dates from 2020 and is headquartered in West Perth.
